sources.license_evidence: NLPC UoM publishes linguistic resources on GitHub for public reuse by design. Fernando & Dias (ICON 2021) released this list as a public linguistic resource and request citation. sources.name: University of Moratuwa verified Sinhala word list
sources.notes: Observed format is "token count" (~280k). Verification is accepted spelling evidence, not a spelling-academy canonical status. Include in the default public export. Cite Fernando & Dias 2021.
